notes: audit_1: hand-built from the generator's traced side outline as a round 'pipe': turned posts (lathe; rosette widths from the trace, rosette height squeezed by 0.45 R because the photos look down on the disc), each elbow a chain of round capsules on a quarter arc, the bar a lathe along X following the traced bar thickness. Replaces the extruded outline, whose large round bevel folded the cap triangulation into fins (and which the studio would silently shrink to near-square edges), and whose W-wide slab feet hid the round rosettes. Width 1/2 in is the plain bar diameter (collars stand proud); the rosettes are the 13/16 in (1 1/8 in app) base spec, wider than Width. Posts lengthened above the rosettes by 0.3-1.2 mm (qa/audit_1_lift.py) so the projection is the spec value.
